rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL: Ghost Broker Policy Pattern Detection")`
`comment("Identifies intermediaries with high policy volume, disposable contacts, below-market premiums")`
index=flame_insurance sourcetype=flame:policy_management
  (policy_type="motor" OR policy_type="vehicle")
| lookup market_premium_lookup risk_category OUTPUT market_avg_premium
| eval premium_pct_of_market = round(premium_amount / market_avg_premium * 100, 1)
| where premium_pct_of_market < 70
| eval is_disposable = if(match(contact_email, "(protonmail|guerrillamail|tempmail|throwaway|yopmail)"), 1, 0)
| stats count AS policy_count,
        dc(contact_email) AS distinct_emails,
        dc(contact_phone) AS distinct_phones,
        avg(premium_amount) AS avg_premium,
        sum(is_disposable) AS disposable_email_count,
        values(market_avg_premium) AS market_avg
  BY intermediary_id, intermediary_name
| where policy_count >= 5
  AND (distinct_emails > policy_count * 0.8 OR disposable_email_count >= 3)
| eval premium_discount = round((1 - avg_premium / market_avg) * 100, 1)
| sort - policy_count
rules.title: DL-0188: Ghost Broker Policy Pattern — Multiple Policies with Disposable Contacts and Below-Market Premiums (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL: Ghost Portal Infrastructure Detection")`
`comment("Insurance verification portals on recently registered domains")`
index=flame_web sourcetype=flame:dns_proxy
  (query="*insurance*verify*" OR query="*policy*check*" OR query="*insurance*confirm*"
   OR query="*motor*verify*" OR query="*cover*check*" OR query="*insure*valid*")
| lookup domain_age_lookup domain AS query OUTPUT domain_registered_date
| eval domain_age_days = round((now() - strptime(domain_registered_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400)
| where domain_age_days < 90
| stats count AS query_count, dc(src_ip) AS unique_requestors,
        values(query) AS domains, min(_time) AS first_seen, max(_time) AS last_seen
  BY domain_registered_date
| where query_count >= 10
| eval days_active = round((last_seen - first_seen) / 86400, 1)
| sort - query_count
rules.title: DL-0189: Ghost Portal Infrastructure Detection — Fake Insurance Verification on Recently Registered Domains (SPLUNK)
